description.value: Log Inn & Pub is a rustic mountain pub and lodge in Avola, BC, sitting on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 5) roughly halfway between Kamloops and Valemount. The pub is locally celebrated for its hand-crafted burgers and cold beer, and the property offers cabin accommodation with home-cooked meals in a remote backcountry setting. It makes a natural food-and-drink waypoint for road cyclists travelling one of BC's great central Interior touring corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Log Inn & Pub is an active pub and lodge in Avola, BC on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 5), offering burgers, cold beer, cabin accommodation, and home-cooked meals including explicitly listed packed lunches. No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, which is marketed almost entirely toward snowmobile tourism. A guest review references 'restrooms in the main building,' confirming washroom availability at the property.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Log Inn Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Log Inn & Pub'.
No street address available in OSM or on the website — only 'Avola, British Columbia' is provided.
Business is marketed primarily toward snowmobile tourism; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operating pub and lodge on the Yellowhead Highway corridor between Kamloops and Valemount; a useful food, drink, and overnight stop for touring cyclists despite being primarily marketed toward snowmobile tourism.

Packed lunches.detail: Explicitly listed under home-cooked meals on the Stay & Eat page: 'Breakfast / Packed lunches / Supper.'
